p7_b4.ocr: Each fund's performance metrics, including total assets and sector classifications, are crucial in guiding investors toward informed, sustainable choices. As we continue to refine our investment strategies, these ESG scores and financial metrics will serve as a cornerstone for our decision- making processes, ensuring that our clients' investments align with their ethical values and financial objectives.
